title: Why Live in Maine?
before:
Welcome 

We are known affectionately as Vacationland.  People love our charming communities and unique geography and come back again and again. We would like to invite you to consider making Maine your home. 

So, pull up a chair and get to know us…We’d love to get to know you.

Come Discover Your Reasons for Calling Maine Home

Spend some time in our communities and their gathering places. Discover the Maine spirit and unique qualities in each community. If you are wondering how to make connections to Maine employers, Live + Work in Maine's Employers web page, is a great place to start. If you have specific questions about a place or are considering test driving Maine for a weekend, the Maine Tourism Association's website can be helpful.  

Find your niche, here in Maine. Come for a visit, stay a lifetime. There is something here in Maine for everyone. Be one of the people. who fell in love with Maine, stayed, and has a great career here.

notes: Heading levels skip: jumps h1 to h3. Needs a person.

decisions.label: Rebuild the heading outline
decisions.why: 2 headings sit at a level the page never opens — "Welcome" is an h3 with no h2 above it, so it is neither announced nor styled as the sub-section it is. Each heading moves to one level below whatever encloses it.

decisions.label: Turn the headings into section headers
decisions.why: 2 headings are plain text where every other page uses a section header, so the page reads as one continuous wall instead of parts.

decisions.label: Give the cards the width their content needs
decisions.why: 1 row holds two cards of very different weight in equal halves, and cards in a row are the same height — so the short one is stretched and the difference shows as empty space. 2.9× — 783 characters beside 274. Only the column widths change.

decisions.label: Set a job title the way the rest of the site does
decisions.why: 1 job title sits in plain text under the person's name, where 186 elsewhere on the site are in italics — so the same contact block is drawn two ways depending on the page, and the title runs into the name above it. The standard here is the site's own, not a preference: two thirds of these blocks already do it. No word changes.

decisions.label: Use this paragraph as the page description
decisions.why: It is the page’s own opening paragraph, moved into the banner rather than rewritten.
decisions.value: We are known affectionately as Vacationland. People love our charming communities and unique geography and come back again and again. We would like to invite you to consider making Maine your home.

decisions.label: Stop a column label claiming to be a section
decisions.why: 2 section headers sit inside a grid column rather than across the page — so a row of three labels claims three sections where there is one, and each turns up in the banner's contents list as somewhere to jump to. They become sub-headings of the section the row is in, with the same mark a heading inside any other component gets. No word changes, and an anchor an author wrote by hand moves onto the heading with it.
